Panel E: tryptase strong cytoplasmic positivity in numerous mast cells
Panel F: weak to moderate membranous CD25 expression in the mast cells
Panels G-I (aspirate): large round mast cells with abundant purple metachromatic granules, some with hypogranular areas, eccentric or bilobed nuclei (promastocyte/atypical forms)
61169.describe_en: This composite shows marrow involvement by a dense infiltrate of large atypical mast cells with abundant pale cytoplasm and irregular, bilobed to multilobed nuclei, admixed with a population of small lymphocytes. Immunohistochemistry shows the large cells to be CD117 (membranous) and tryptase positive with aberrant CD25 expression, while a CD19/LEF1 double stain highlights the small lymphoid cells of chronic lymphocytic leukemia. Aspirate smears show numerous large, round atypical mast cells with dense metachromatic granules and focal hypogranularity, including immature forms. Findings are consistent with mast cell leukemia (aleukemic, given the context) with an associated hematologic neoplasm, here CLL and CMML; mast cell percentage on the aspirate (at least 20%) and KIT D816V testing support the diagnosis.

ddx.dx: Systemic mastocytosis (non-leukemic) with associated hematologic neoplasm
ddx.vs: SM-AHN has compact spindle mast cell aggregates with fewer than 20% mast cells on the aspirate, whereas mast cell leukemia shows at least 20% round atypical mast cells on smears.
Myelomastocytic leukemia occurs in advanced myeloid neoplasms with metachromatic blasts and immature mast cells that lack SM criteria such as compact aggregates, CD25 expression or KIT D816V.
Basophils have segmented nuclei and water-soluble granules and are CD123/CD203c positive but tryptase weak and CD117 negative.
Reactive mast cells are scattered, round to spindle, well granulated and CD25/CD2 negative, without sheets or atypia.

61169.stain: H&E, Wright-Giemsa, IHC: CD19/LEF1, CD117, tryptase, CD25

61105.recognize_zh: 周邊血可見多顆中小型淋巴球，核圓、染色質濃密、細胞質少而深藍，部分有細胞質突起；心肌切片中淋巴球沿心肌纖維間浸潤並伴隨心肌細胞破壞，免疫染色顯示浸潤細胞為 T 細胞，代表 T-PLL 侵犯心臟。
features: PB (A): increased small to medium lymphocytes with round to slightly irregular nuclei, condensed chromatin and scant deeply basophilic cytoplasm; one cell with a cytoplasmic bleb
Nucleoli not resolvable at this image resolution
Heart (B): dense perivascular and interstitial lymphoid infiltrate dissecting between cardiomyocytes
Myocyte injury with separation and loss of fibers adjacent to the infiltrate
IHC (C-E): infiltrating cells strongly positive for T-cell-associated markers (antigens not labeled), in interstitial and perivascular distribution
61105.describe_en: Composite figure. The peripheral blood smear shows an increase in small to medium-sized lymphocytes with round nuclei, condensed chromatin, scant basophilic cytoplasm and occasional cytoplasmic blebs; nucleoli cannot be assessed at this resolution. Sections of myocardium show a dense perivascular and interstitial lymphoid infiltrate dissecting between and damaging cardiomyocytes. Immunostains label the infiltrating cells in the same interstitial distribution, consistent with a T-cell phenotype. Findings are consistent with cardiac involvement by T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia, with the clinical correlate of heart failure.

ddx.vs: Myocarditis contains a polyclonal mixed T-cell infiltrate without a concurrent leukemic population, TCL1 expression or clonal TRA/TRB rearrangement.
ATLL cells have polylobated flower-shaped nuclei, are CD25 positive and HTLV-1 associated.
Sezary cells have cerebriform nuclei and a history of erythroderma, and are TCL1 negative.
CLL cells are B cells (CD19, CD20 dim, CD23, CD5) with soccer-ball chromatin and smudge cells.

61041.recognize_zh: 高倍下可見成群、胞質透明且核稍不規則的中型非典型細胞，圍繞在內皮細胞肥厚的高內皮小靜脈旁，並混有免疫母細胞、組織球、漿細胞及有絲分裂像，符合 AITL 的透明細胞群聚。
features: Clusters of medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with abundant clear cytoplasm and distinct cell borders
Irregular nuclei with vesicular to moderately condensed chromatin
High endothelial venules with plump endothelial cells and hyalinized walls
Admixed immunoblasts with prominent nucleoli, histiocytes and plasma cells
Scattered mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies; extravasated red cells
61041.describe_en: High-power view of lymph node shows clusters of medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with abundant clear cytoplasm and irregular nuclei, arranged around high endothelial venules with plump endothelium. The background is polymorphous, containing immunoblasts, epithelioid histiocytes and plasma cells, with scattered mitotic figures. Findings are consistent with angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma, to be confirmed by TFH immunophenotype and T-cell receptor clonality.

ddx.vs: PTCL-NOS lacks a consistent TFH immunophenotype and the characteristic clear-cell clusters around proliferating HEVs.
Scattered large cells in TCRBCL are CD20+ B cells, whereas AITL clear cells are CD3+/PD-1+ T cells.
Reactive proliferations lack aggregates of atypical clear T cells and are polyclonal by TCR studies.

exam.answer_en: Angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma — clusters of atypical clear cells around high endothelial venules in a polymorphous background
pearls_zh: 考法：高倍指透明胞質的中型細胞群問其來源 → 腫瘤性 TFH 細胞；並指旁邊內皮肥厚的血管（HEV）。
腫瘤細胞表型：CD3+、CD4+，並表現 ≥2 個 TFH 標記（PD-1、CXCL13、ICOS、BCL6、CD10）。
背景 EBV+ B 免疫母細胞常見，應做 EBER；部分病例可續發 EBV+ 大 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
WHO 5th 與 ICC 2022 將 AITL 歸入 nodal TFH-cell lymphoma，與 follicular type、NOS 並列。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma；TCRBCL 的大細胞為 CD20+ B 細胞，AITL 的透明細胞則為 CD3+/PD-1+ T 細胞。

quiz.q: 圖中胞質透明的中型非典型淋巴球來源於哪一種 T 細胞亞群？

60977.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中可見兩大團深藍色細菌：一團散在細胞外、落在破碎的淡染細胞質殘骸上，另一團密集堆在嗜中性球內；周圍嗜中性球細胞質明顯空泡化並含細小顆粒，代表嚴重菌血症。本圖菌體多呈短棒狀／成對排列，單憑 Wright 染色無法確認是否為題目所稱的葡萄球菌。
features: Two dense aggregates of small, deeply basophilic bacteria between and within leukocytes
Upper aggregate: bacteria lying on a smudged, pale cytoplasmic remnant, appearing largely extracellular
Lower aggregate: tightly packed bacteria within a neutrophil with vacuolated cytoplasm
Organisms appear as short rods/coccobacilli and paired forms rather than clearly spherical clusters
Several neutrophils with prominent cytoplasmic vacuolization and fine granular debris (toxic change, degeneration)
Red cells unremarkable apart from mild anisocytosis
60977.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous small, darkly basophilic bacteria forming two aggregates, one lying free on disrupted cytoplasmic debris and one packed within a neutrophil. Adjacent neutrophils show marked cytoplasmic vacuolization with fine granular debris, in keeping with phagocytosis and cell degeneration. On Wright-Giemsa stain the organisms appear as short rods or paired coccoid forms; morphology on a Romanowsky-stained smear cannot reliably distinguish cocci from coccobacilli or identify species, so correlation with Gram stain and blood culture (reported as Staphylococcus capitis) is essential. Findings are consistent with overwhelming bacteremia with both free and phagocytosed organisms.

ddx.vs: Contaminants lie in a different focal plane, are not phagocytosed and are not accompanied by neutrophil vacuolization; blood culture confirms true bacteremia.
Platelets show granular centers and variable size, and stain precipitate is refractile and irregular, unlike uniform discrete bacterial bodies.
Fungi are larger (2-5 µm), oval with budding or a clear halo, compared with these tiny uniform bacteria.
Morulae are single mulberry-like inclusions within an intact vacuole rather than large numbers of discrete free and intracellular organisms.

exam.answer_en: Overwhelming bacteremia — free and neutrophil-phagocytosed bacteria with vacuolated neutrophils (species needs Gram stain/culture)
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指兩團深藍色小菌體，問「游離還是被吞噬」及意義 → 同時有細胞外與嗜中性球內細菌，代表高菌量菌血症，屬需立即通報臨床的 critical value。
Wright-Giemsa 染色下細菌皆呈嗜鹼性，無法分 Gram 陽性/陰性，也難可靠區分球菌與短桿菌；應同一片或 buffy coat 做 Gram stain，並抽血培養。
周邊血看得到細菌的常見情境：中心靜脈導管感染、脾切除或功能低下（如 Capnocytophaga canimorsus、肺炎鏈球菌）、嚴重免疫低下與 overwhelming sepsis。
伴隨的 toxic change（空泡化、toxic granulation、Döhle bodies）支持真正感染，並可提示病程嚴重度。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最需排除污染或檢體久置造成的體外細菌增生：污染菌不被吞噬、不在同一焦平面且無嗜中性球空泡化；真正菌血症有吞噬現象並經血液培養證實。

quiz.q: 圖中嗜中性球內與細胞外成團的深藍色小顆粒是什麼？為何不能只憑此抹片判定菌種？下一步做什麼？
quiz.a: 細菌（游離與被吞噬，提示高菌量菌血症）；Wright 染色無法分 Gram 性質與菌種；立即做 Gram stain 與血液培養並通報臨床

60913.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中聚集成群的大型細胞，細胞質深藍且有小空泡、細胞彼此黏附；切片為成片的圓形藍細胞，免疫染色呈細胞核陽性（肌源性標記），流式顯示 CD45 陰性、CD56 陽性，細胞遺傳與 FISH 顯示 FOXO1 相關轉位，符合轉移性腺泡型橫紋肌肉瘤。
features: Aspirate: cohesive clusters of large cells with high N:C ratio, round nuclei, fine chromatin and deeply basophilic, finely vacuolated cytoplasm
Biopsy: diffuse sheets of monotonous small round blue cells replacing marrow
IHC: strong nuclear staining in the majority of tumor cells (consistent with myogenin/MyoD1)
Flow cytometry: 98.9% of events CD45-negative/CD56-positive; only 0.6% CD45+CD14+ cells
Metaphase karyotype/FISH images with arrows marking translocation partners and interphase break-apart pattern (1R1G1F) versus normal (2F)
60913.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate contains cohesive clusters of large tumor cells with round nuclei, fine chromatin, high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio and deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm, which could be mistaken for leukemic blasts. The trephine is diffusely replaced by sheets of small round blue cells, which show strong nuclear immunoreactivity with a myogenic transcription factor stain. Flow cytometry shows that nearly all events are CD45-negative and CD56-positive. Metaphase and interphase FISH demonstrate a translocation (arrows) and an interphase split-signal (1R1G1F) pattern indicating a gene rearrangement, which in this context corresponds to the FOXO1 rearrangement of alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma (probe identity not labeled in the figure). Findings are consistent with metastatic alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma, first diagnosed on bone marrow.

ddx.dx: Acute leukemia (including acute megakaryoblastic or monoblastic leukemia)
ddx.vs: Leukemic blasts are discohesive and CD45-positive, whereas these cohesive clusters are CD45-negative with nuclear myogenin.
Neuroblastoma forms Homer-Wright rosettes with neuropil and is PHOX2B/synaptophysin positive and myogenin negative.
Ewing cells show membranous CD99 and NKX2-2 with EWSR1 rearrangement rather than FOXO1 rearrangement and myogenin.
Myeloma cells are CD138+/CD38 bright with eccentric nuclei and hof, not myogenin positive.

60849.recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結中，淡粉紅色、細胞豐富的病灶呈地圖狀大片分布，擴張淋巴竇並延伸至副皮質區，將深紫色的淋巴組織與濾泡分隔開來，並伴隨局部出血，這種竇內分布的淡染細胞群是淋巴結 LCH 的低倍線索。
features: Low-power lymph node with architecture partially effaced by geographic pale eosinophilic cellular areas
Pale aggregates distend sinuses and extend into paracortex, separating darker basophilic lymphoid tissue
Residual lymphoid follicles, some with germinal centers, surrounded by the pale infiltrate
Focal hemorrhage within the pale areas
Cytologic detail (nuclear grooves, eosinophils) not resolvable at this magnification
60849.describe_en: Low-power hematoxylin and eosin-stained section of a lymph node shows partial effacement of architecture by broad, geographic zones of pale eosinophilic cells that distend the sinuses and extend focally into the paracortex. Residual darker lymphoid areas and follicles with germinal centers are preserved between the pale zones, and focal hemorrhage is present. Cytologic features cannot be assessed at this magnification. The sinusoidal distribution of pale histiocytoid cells is consistent with nodal involvement by Langerhans cell histiocytosis, to be confirmed at high power and with CD1a/langerin immunostains.

ddx.vs: Rosai-Dorfman also distends sinuses with pale histiocytes and plasma cells, but at high power shows large S-100+ histiocytes with emperipolesis and lacks CD1a/langerin.
Reactive sinus histiocytosis dilates sinuses with bland CD68+ macrophages without grooved nuclei or eosinophil-rich infiltrates.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or melanoma in sinuses
ddx.vs: Metastases in sinuses consist of cohesive atypical epithelial or melanocytic cells positive for keratin or SOX10/Melan-A.
ALCL shows sinusoidal large pleomorphic hallmark cells that are CD30/ALK positive.

60785.recognize_zh: 視野中央兩顆細胞含深紫黑色、粗大的顆粒，顆粒部分覆蓋細胞核並聚集於一側，形態為正常嗜鹼性球；與 inv(16) AML 的異常嗜酸性球（橘紅色顆粒夾雜大型紫色顆粒）不同，背景還有散落的顆粒與母細胞。
features: Two cells with coarse, dark purple-black granules partly overlying the nucleus and crowded at one pole (basophils)
Granules are uniformly dark without an admixture of orange-red eosinophilic granules
Adjacent cell with blue cytoplasm and coarse dark granules over the nucleus (lower left)
Larger cells with fine chromatin and pale, poorly granular cytoplasm consistent with blasts/monocytoid cells
Background scattered dark granules released from disrupted cells
60785.describe_en: Aspirate smear shows two cells containing coarse, dark purple-black granules that partially obscure the nucleus, morphologically consistent with basophils, together with an additional granulated cell and several larger cells with fine chromatin and pale cytoplasm. The granules are uniformly dark and lack the orange eosinophilic granules that coexist with large basophilic granules in the abnormal eosinophils of inv(16). Released granules are scattered in the background. In this relapsed AML with inv(16), these are normal basophils and should not be counted as abnormal eosinophils.

ddx.dx: Abnormal eosinophils of AML with inv(16)
ddx.vs: Show a mixture of orange eosinophilic granules with large, irregular purple-violet proeosinophilic granules, mostly in immature eosinophils with unsegmented nuclei.
Are larger with round central nucleus and densely packed cytoplasm-filling granules, often spindle-shaped, rather than granules overlying a lobated nucleus.
Consists of fine dark azurophilic granules evenly distributed in pink cytoplasm of segmented neutrophils, not coarse granules obscuring the nucleus.

60593.recognize_zh: 抹片中可見一條捲曲的大型蠕蟲狀幼蟲，體內充滿密集排列的深藍色細胞核柱，外圍有一層淡粉紅透明的鞘膜（sheath）延伸超出蟲體前後端，符合有鞘微絲蟲（microfilaria），指向蚊媒傳播的淋巴絲蟲病。
features: Large coiled larval nematode many times the size of surrounding leukocytes
Body filled with a column of densely packed, dark blue somatic nuclei
Clear, pale pink sheath enveloping the body and extending beyond the ends of the organism
Cephalic space at the anterior end; tail nuclei detail not clearly resolvable in this image
Background with scattered leukocytes and no intact red cells (thick film or fluid preparation), plus extraneous fibers
60593.describe_en: Giemsa-type stained preparation shows a large, coiled, sheathed microfilaria with a column of densely packed dark somatic nuclei and a distinct clear sheath extending beyond the body, surrounded by scattered leukocytes in a background lacking intact red cells, suggestive of a thick blood film. The anterior cephalic space is visible, but the arrangement of nuclei in the tail tip cannot be assessed confidently at this resolution. Findings are consistent with a sheathed microfilaria of lymphatic filariasis (Wuchereria bancrofti or Brugia species); species identification requires assessment of tail nuclei, and specimens are best collected at night for nocturnally periodic species.

ddx.vs: Also sheathed, but nuclei extend continuously to the tip of the tail and the sheath stains poorly with Giemsa; diurnal periodicity and African rainforest exposure support it.
Brugia has two separate terminal tail nuclei and a pink-staining sheath with Giemsa, whereas Wuchereria has a tail tip free of nuclei.
Mansonella microfilariae are smaller and unsheathed.
Strongyloides larvae are unsheathed with a visible buccal cavity and differentiated gut and genital primordium rather than a uniform nuclear column.

exam.answer_en: Sheathed microfilaria (lymphatic filariasis: Wuchereria bancrofti/Brugia) — coiled larva with column of somatic nuclei and sheath extending beyond body
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指蟲體外圍超出頭尾的透明膜問「有沒有 sheath」，再問蟲種鑑定要看哪裡——答尾端核（tail nuclei）的排列。
尾端核鑑別：W. bancrofti 尾端無核；Brugia malayi 尾端有兩顆分離的末端核；Loa loa 核連續到尾尖。Giemsa 下 Brugia 鞘膜染粉紅，W. bancrofti 鞘膜幾乎不著色。
採檢時機：淋巴絲蟲多為夜間週期性（nocturnal periodicity），應在夜間（約晚上 10 點至凌晨 2 點）抽血；W. bancrofti 另可檢測 circulating filarial antigen。
臨床與治療：淋巴水腫/象皮病、乳糜尿、hydrocele、tropical pulmonary eosinophilia；治療常用 DEC，但 Loa loa 高微絲蟲血症使用 DEC 可能誘發腦病變，須先排除。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 Loa loa 混淆：兩者都有 sheath，但 Loa loa 為白天週期性、流行於非洲雨林，尾端核連續到尾尖；淋巴絲蟲則為夜間週期性，尾端核排列依蟲種不同。

quiz.q: 看到這種有鞘微絲蟲，要鑑定 W. bancrofti 或 Brugia malayi 應觀察哪個構造？兩者差異為何？
quiz.a: 尾端核（tail nuclei）：W. bancrofti 尾尖無核；B. malayi 尾端有兩顆分離的末端核。

60657.recognize_zh: 脾臟切面瀰漫性腫大、呈均勻暗紅色而無結節；組織切片中淋巴瘤細胞充塞紅髓脾竇，肝臟與骨髓切片（箭頭）亦見腫瘤細胞侷限於竇狀隙內浸潤，這種竇內分布模式是肝脾 T 細胞淋巴瘤的特徵。
features: Panel A (gross): enlarged spleen with homogeneous dark red cut surface and no discrete nodules (red pulp expansion, white pulp not apparent)
Panel B (H&E): red pulp expanded by monotonous medium-sized lymphoid cells with round nuclei, fine chromatin, small nucleoli and moderate pale cytoplasm filling cords and sinuses
Panel C (IHC, antigen not labeled): positive cells distributed in a sinusoidal/cordal pattern throughout the red pulp
Panel D (liver, H&E): clusters of atypical lymphoid cells within hepatic sinusoids (arrow) without portal-based masses
Panel E (bone marrow): subtle intrasinusoidal lymphoid infiltrate in a hypocellular fatty marrow (arrows)
60657.describe_en: Splenectomy specimen shows diffuse splenomegaly with a homogeneous beefy red cut surface without nodules. Histologically, the red pulp cords and sinusoids are infiltrated by monotonous medium-sized lymphoid cells with round nuclei and moderate pale cytoplasm, with white pulp atrophy, and an immunostain highlights the sinusoidal distribution of the tumor cells. Liver and bone marrow sections show similar cells confined to hepatic and marrow sinusoids. Findings are consistent with hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma; confirmation with CD3+, CD5−, CD4−/CD8−, TCRγδ, cytotoxic markers (TIA-1+, granzyme B−) and isochromosome 7q is recommended.

ddx.vs: T-LGL cells have abundant cytoplasm with azurophilic granules, are usually CD8+/TCRαβ, granzyme B+ and have a more indolent course without i(7q).
Aggressive NK-cell leukemia is surface CD3 negative, CD56+ and EBV-positive, whereas HSTCL is EBV negative.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: It also involves red pulp and marrow sinusoids but consists of CD20+ B cells with villous cytoplasm.
HCL shows red pulp blood lakes with fried-egg cells that are CD20+, CD11c+, CD25+, CD103+ and annexin A1/BRAF V600E positive.

exam.answer_en: Hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma — diffuse red pulp splenomegaly with monotonous medium-sized T cells infiltrating splenic, hepatic and marrow sinusoids
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指脾臟紅髓、肝竇與骨髓竇內的淋巴瘤細胞，問「分布模式」——答 sinusoidal infiltration，並連結無淋巴結腫大的肝脾腫大表現。
表型：CD3+、CD5−、CD4−/CD8−（部分 CD8+）、CD56 可陽性；多為 TCRγδ（少數 αβ）；TIA-1+ 而 granzyme B/perforin 多為陰性（非活化型細胞毒性表型）；EBV 陰性。
遺傳：isochromosome 7q 為特徵，常合併 trisomy 8；常見 SETD2、STAT5B、STAT3 突變。
臨床連結：好發年輕男性，與長期免疫抑制相關（特別是發炎性腸病使用 thiopurine 合併 anti-TNF）；病程侵襲、預後差，治療常以誘導化療後接 allogeneic HSCT。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 T-LGL leukemia：兩者都可侵犯脾紅髓與骨髓竇，但 T-LGL 細胞有嗜天青顆粒、多為 CD8+/TCRαβ、granzyme B 陽性、病程緩慢且無 i(7q)。

quiz.q: 此淋巴瘤最具特徵的細胞遺傳異常為何？腫瘤細胞通常表現哪一型 T 細胞受體？

60721.recognize_zh: 周邊血中一群核大、染色質細緻的單核母細胞旁邊，有從細胞質脫落、大小似血小板但顏色偏灰藍且無顆粒的碎片（箭頭），與真正的紫色顆粒狀血小板（箭頭頭）不同；細胞化學染色中碎片與母細胞同樣呈陽性，證實為假血小板（pseudoplatelets）。
features: Large blasts with round to folded nuclei, fine lacy chromatin, and moderate gray-blue cytoplasm consistent with monoblasts/promonocytes
Small platelet-sized cytoplasmic fragments budding from or lying next to blasts (arrows), pale gray-blue and agranular
True platelets (arrowheads) are smaller and purple with granular centers
Cytochemistry (B): blasts show strong dark reaction product, and the pseudoplatelet fragment (arrow) is also positive while true platelets (arrowheads) are negative
Background red cells without significant poikilocytosis
60721.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous large blasts with fine chromatin, folded to round nuclei and moderate gray-blue cytoplasm, consistent with monoblasts and promonocytes. Several small platelet-sized fragments of blast cytoplasm are seen detaching from or adjacent to the leukemic cells; these are agranular and paler than the true platelets present in the field. On cytochemical staining the fragments share the strong reaction product of the blasts, whereas genuine platelets are nonreactive. Findings are consistent with pseudoplatelets (leukemic cytoplasmic fragments) in acute monocytic leukemia, which can spuriously elevate automated platelet counts.

ddx.vs: Genuine platelets are purple with central azurophilic granules and do not share the cytochemical reaction of the blasts.
Schistocytes are pink, hemoglobinized and angular, while pseudoplatelets are gray-blue and match blast cytoplasm.
Megakaryocytic fragments are CD41/CD61 positive and often show blebbing with granules, whereas these fragments stain like monocytic blast cytoplasm.
Organisms have defined walls or uniform shape and staining, rather than irregular pale cytoplasmic blebs continuous with blasts.

captions: Wright-Giemsa: monocytic blasts with platelet-sized cytoplasmic fragments (arrows) versus true platelets (arrowheads)
Cytochemistry: positive blasts and positive pseudoplatelet (arrow), negative true platelets (arrowheads)

60529.recognize_zh: 免疫組織化學染色（未標示抗體）中，許多小至中型淋巴細胞呈清楚的環狀膜染色，成群散佈；夾在其間、細胞核卵圓淡染而細長的類上皮組織球則為陰性，呈現陽性淋巴細胞與陰性組織球交錯的圖像。
features: IHC with brown DAB chromogen and hematoxylin counterstain; antibody not labeled
Crisp membranous (ring-like) positivity in numerous small-to-medium lymphoid cells, some in small clusters
Positive cells have mildly irregular nuclei
Negative intervening cells with elongated to oval pale nuclei and abundant cytoplasm, resembling epithelioid histiocytes
Positive population is substantial but not confluent, leaving histiocyte-rich negative zones
60529.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain shows crisp membranous positivity in numerous small-to-medium lymphoid cells with mildly irregular nuclei, arranged singly and in small clusters. They are intermixed with negative cells bearing oval to elongated pale nuclei and abundant cytoplasm, consistent with epithelioid histiocytes. The antibody is not labeled, so the marker cannot be identified from the image, although the membranous pattern in lymphoid cells is typical of a T-cell antigen. In the context of the title, the image illustrates the T-cell infiltrate admixed with numerous epithelioid histiocytes in lymphoepithelioid (Lennert) lymphoma, a variant of peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS.

ddx.vs: Reactive T cells lack aberrant antigen loss and are polyclonal by TCR gene rearrangement studies.
Hodgkin lymphoma requires CD30+/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg cells, which would be negative for T-cell markers.
AITL shows TFH marker expression and CD21+ expanded follicular dendritic cell networks around vessels.

60401.recognize_zh: 中央右側這顆細胞的核碎裂成許多大小不一、圓形、深紫色且互不相連的均質小球，但細胞質仍保留淡粉紅色的中性顆粒；旁邊另一顆細胞核濃縮成單一深染棒狀塊。背景大量棘狀紅血球（echinocytes）提示檢體放置過久，符合退化／壞死中的嗜中性球。
features: Neutrophil-sized cell with nucleus fragmented into multiple round, dense, homogeneous, unconnected purple globules (karyorrhexis)
Retained pale pink neutrophilic granules in the cytoplasm of the degenerating cells
Adjacent cell with a single condensed, homogeneous dark (pyknotic) nuclear mass and granular cytoplasm
Nearby smudged/distorted leukocytes in a cluster at the thick edge of the clump
Numerous crenated red cells (echinocytes) in background, consistent with storage/drying artifact; intact normal neutrophils elsewhere
60401.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a small cluster of leukocytes in which one neutrophil has a nucleus broken into multiple round, dense, homogeneous fragments that are not connected by chromatin strands, while its cytoplasm retains fine neutrophilic granules. An adjacent cell has a single condensed, pyknotic nuclear mass. The background contains many echinocytes, and intact segmented neutrophils are present at the periphery of the field. These changes represent degenerating (necrobiotic/apoptotic) neutrophils, likely accentuated by prolonged specimen storage; retained cytoplasmic granules distinguish them from nucleated red cells.

ddx.vs: Nucleated red cells have agranular, hemoglobinized orange-gray cytoplasm around a single round nucleus, whereas degenerating neutrophils keep their fine cytoplasmic granules.
Hypersegmented neutrophils have 6 or more lobes connected by chromatin bridges with normal chromatin texture, not dense, homogeneous, separate spheres.

ddx.dx: Neutrophil with phagocytosed material (e.g., ingested apoptotic cells or organisms)
ddx.vs: Phagocytosed bodies sit within vacuoles alongside a separate intact lobulated nucleus, while in degeneration the nucleus itself is replaced by the fragments.
Myelokathexis lobes remain joined by thin filaments and occur in fresh marrow/blood of neutropenic patients, not as isolated cells in a storage-artifact smear.

exam.answer_en: Degenerating (necrobiotic) neutrophils — karyorrhectic nuclear fragments with retained neutrophilic granules, storage artifact with echinocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指核碎裂成多顆不相連均質小球的細胞，問是否為過度分葉或有核紅血球；答退化嗜中性球（核碎裂 karyorrhexis、核固縮 pyknosis）。
常見原因是 EDTA 血液放置過久才推片，背景同時出現大量棘狀紅血球（echinocytes）是檢體老化的線索；抹片宜於採血後數小時內製作。
臨床影響：退化細胞可造成自動血球計數器分類錯誤（如誤判為 nRBC 或淋巴球），嚴重感染或體液檢體中也可見。
與 myelokathexis 比較：後者為體內病變，核葉以細長絲相連且見於新鮮骨髓；退化細胞核碎片完全不相連並伴其他儲存假影。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為有核紅血球或 megaloblastic 過度分葉嗜中性球；保留的粉紅色中性顆粒證明是嗜中性球，核碎片不相連則排除真正的分葉。

quiz.q: 這顆核碎裂成多個不相連圓形小球、但仍保有中性顆粒的細胞是什麼？背景棘狀紅血球提示什麼前處理問題？
quiz.a: 退化/凋亡嗜中性球（karyorrhexis）；檢體放置過久（storage artifact）

60273.recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結被膜完整、周邊保留淋巴濾泡，其間與皮質旁區可見大片淡粉紅、細胞較稀疏的區域（組織球聚集）穿插於深藍色淋巴細胞之間，結構仍保留，符合反應性竇組織球增生（sinus histiocytosis）。
features: Intact thin fibrous capsule with preserved overall nodal architecture
Scattered lymphoid follicles, some with discernible germinal centers/mantle zones
Nodular and band-like pale eosinophilic areas expanding sinuses and paracortex, composed of loosely arranged histiocytes
Central hilar-type fibrous tissue with small vessels
Occasional brown pigment granules; no sheets of atypical cells discernible at this magnification
60273.describe_en: Low power section of lymph node shows an intact capsule with preserved architecture, including scattered secondary follicles. There is prominent expansion of sinusoidal and paracortical regions by pale eosinophilic aggregates of histiocytes, imparting a mottled appearance. No capsular infiltration, effacement or sheets of atypical cells are identified at this magnification, although cytologic detail is limited. Findings are consistent with reactive sinus histiocytosis.

ddx.vs: Shows massively dilated sinuses filled with large pale histiocytes displaying emperipolesis and S100 positivity, which requires high power and IHC to confirm.
Cohesive epithelial cells with atypia and keratin positivity rather than bland histiocytes with CD68/CD163 positivity.
Sinus cells have grooved, reniform nuclei with eosinophils and are CD1a/langerin positive.
Large pleomorphic hallmark cells with strong CD30 expression populate sinuses, unlike bland histiocytes.

60145.recognize_zh: 抽吸抹片以大量芽細胞為主：中至大型、核圓、染色質細緻、部分可見核仁，胞質中等量呈藍色、少數含空泡，夾雜少數顆粒球；單看形態只能判定急性白血病，混合表現型急性白血病（MPAL）必須靠流式細胞儀證明兩系表現。
features: Sheet of blasts, intermediate to large, with round to slightly indented nuclei and high N:C ratio
Finely dispersed chromatin with occasional distinct nucleoli
Moderate basophilic, agranular cytoplasm; one blast with prominent cytoplasmic vacuoles; no Auer rods seen
Some smaller blasts with scant cytoplasm and less conspicuous nucleoli (heterogeneous blast population)
Few residual maturing neutrophils (band and bilobed forms) with granular cytoplasm
60145.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a marked increase in blasts, which replace most normal hematopoietic elements. The blasts are heterogeneous: many are intermediate to large with round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, occasional nucleoli and moderate agranular basophilic cytoplasm, some with vacuoles, while others are smaller with scant cytoplasm. No Auer rods are identified, and only a few residual maturing neutrophils are present. Morphology establishes acute leukemia but cannot assign lineage; with flow cytometric evidence of both myeloid/monocytic and lymphoid lineage commitment (and KMT2A rearrangement), the findings are consistent with mixed phenotype acute leukemia.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation (KMT2A-rearranged)
ddx.vs: Morphologically similar vacuolated blasts occur, so separation depends on flow cytometry showing absence of lineage-defining lymphoid markers such as cytoplasmic CD3 or strong CD19 with CD79a/CD22/CD10.
B-ALL blasts are typically smaller with scant cytoplasm and lack myeloid markers such as MPO or monocytic differentiation (lysozyme, CD11c, CD14, CD64, NSE).
Plasmablasts show eccentric nuclei, perinuclear hof and deeply basophilic cytoplasm, with CD138/CD38 positivity and light-chain restriction.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with numerous sharply punched-out vacuoles in most cells and a mature B-cell phenotype with MYC rearrangement.

60081.recognize_zh: 中倍視野內可數到十個以上大型巨核細胞，細胞質豐富、核多葉或深度分葉，彼此分散在造血組織中而非密集成簇，背景細胞量高；這種「大而成熟、分散分布」的巨核細胞增生是本態性血小板增多症（ET）的典型切片表現。
features: Hypercellular marrow with markedly increased megakaryocytes
Megakaryocytes large to giant with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm
Nuclei deeply lobulated/hyperlobated with mature chromatin
Megakaryocytes dispersed singly throughout the marrow, without tight clusters
Background erythroid and granulocytic precursors with preserved maturation; dilated sinusoids
60081.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with a marked increase in megakaryocytes. The megakaryocytes are predominantly large with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and deeply lobulated or hyperlobated nuclei, and they are dispersed individually throughout the interstitium rather than forming dense clusters. Erythroid and granulocytic lineages appear to mature normally, with no increase in blasts and no obvious fibrosis on H&E. Findings are consistent with essential thrombocythemia, pending correlation with platelet count, driver mutation status, and reticulin grade.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes are dysplastic with hyperchromatic, bulbous cloud-like nuclei and abnormal N:C ratio, forming tight clusters, often with increased reticulin.
Shows panmyelosis with pleomorphic megakaryocytes of varying size and prominent erythroid hyperplasia, with elevated hemoglobin.

ddx.dx: MDS/MPN with ring sideroblasts and thrombocytosis
ddx.vs: Has similar large megakaryocytes but shows erythroid dysplasia and >=15% ring sideroblasts on iron stain, often with SF3B1 mutation.
Reactive megakaryocytes lack the consistent giant hyperlobated forms, and the clinical context (bleeding, iron deficiency, inflammation) and absent JAK2/CALR/MPL mutation support it.

exam.answer_en: Essential thrombocythemia — marked increase of large to giant mature megakaryocytes with hyperlobulated nuclei dispersed singly in the marrow
pearls_zh: 考法：中倍數巨核細胞數量與分布；考官會問「是否成簇、核是否深染異型」，用來區分 ET、prefibrotic PMF 與 PV。
必做檢查：JAK2 V617F、CALR、MPL 突變，BCR::ABL1 排除 CML，reticulin 染色評估纖維化程度（ET 通常 grade 0，偶為 grade 1）。
與 PV 區分：PV 為 panmyelosis、巨核細胞大小多形，且 Hb/Hct 升高；JAK2 陽性合併血小板高者須先補鐵或評估 Hb 以免漏診被缺鐵掩蓋的 PV。
臨床：ET 需依年齡、血栓病史與 JAK2 狀態評估血栓風險；CALR 突變病人血小板常較高但血栓風險相對較低；長期可轉為 post-ET MF 或急性白血病。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為反應性血小板增多（如缺鐵、發炎、脾切除後）：反應性巨核細胞雖增多但形態正常、不呈大型過度分葉且無 driver mutation；也要與 MDS/MPN-RS-T 區分，後者有環狀鐵粒母細胞與 SF3B1 突變。

quiz.q: 切片如圖巨核細胞明顯增多且分散，除 JAK2/CALR/MPL 外，還必須做哪個分子檢查排除另一種 MPN？

60017.recognize_zh: 流式圖中紅色母細胞 CD45 弱陽，表現 CD34、HLA-DR 與強陽性 CD7，但細胞內 MPO、CD19 與細胞內 CD3 皆為陰性；缺乏任何系別特異標記（MPO、cCD3、CD19 強陽），加上 CD7 本身非系別特異，符合未分化型急性白血病。
features: Red-gated blasts with dim CD45, distinct from bright CD45 lymphocytes
CD34 positive (broad, moderate to bright) and HLA-DR positive
CD7 bright positive (not lineage specific)
Intracellular MPO negative
CD19 negative and intracellular CD3 negative, with normal gray T cells as internal positive control
60017.describe_en: Flow cytometric plots show a red-gated blast population with dim CD45 expression. The blasts express CD34, HLA-DR, and bright CD7, but are negative for intracellular myeloperoxidase, CD19, and intracellular CD3, with residual normal T cells serving as a positive internal control for CD3. CD7 is not lineage specific and does not assign T lineage in the absence of cytoplasmic CD3. The lack of lineage-defining markers, together with absence of other myeloid, B, megakaryocytic, and monocytic antigens, is consistent with acute undifferentiated leukemia after exclusion of BPDCN and other rare entities.

ddx.vs: ETP-ALL is CD7 positive but requires cytoplasmic CD3 expression, which is absent in these blasts.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: AML-M0 can be CD7 and CD34 positive and MPO negative but expresses myeloid markers such as CD13, CD33, or CD117, reported as negative here.
BPDCN may be CD7 positive but is characteristically CD4, CD56, and bright CD123 positive and usually CD34 negative.
MPAL T/myeloid requires both cytoplasmic CD3 and MPO or monocytic differentiation, both lacking here.

24177.recognize_zh: 淋巴結切片中有大片壞死與發炎細胞浸潤，高倍可見大型細胞核呈毛玻璃樣（ground-glass）、染色質推向核膜並有核相互擠壓（molding）與多核，IHC 對 HSV 抗原強陽性，符合疱疹病毒淋巴結炎（CLL 治療後免疫低下）。
features: Lymph node with effaced architecture, necrosis and a mixed inflammatory infiltrate (panel A)
Enlarged cells with smudged, glassy ground-glass nuclei and chromatin margination
Nuclear molding and multinucleation (viral cytopathic effect) in a necrotic, edematous background (panel B)
Karyorrhectic debris without organized granulomas
IHC for HSV shows strong nuclear and cytoplasmic staining of numerous cells in necrotic areas (panel C)
24177.describe_en: Lymph node sections show extensive necrosis with a mixed inflammatory infiltrate and karyorrhectic debris effacing the nodal architecture. At high power, numerous enlarged cells show glassy, smudged nuclei with chromatin margination, nuclear molding and multinucleation, characteristic of herpesvirus cytopathic effect. Immunohistochemistry for herpes simplex virus is strongly positive in abundant cells within the necrotic areas. Residual small lymphocytes of CLL and Richter transformation are not evident in the illustrated fields. Findings are consistent with herpes simplex virus lymphadenitis in an immunosuppressed patient with CLL.

ddx.vs: Large cells in Richter transformation have vesicular nuclei with prominent nucleoli and are CD20/PAX5 positive, not glassy molded nuclei staining for HSV.
Kikuchi shows crescentic histiocytes and plasmacytoid dendritic cells without neutrophils or viral inclusions, and HSV IHC is negative.
CMV produces cytomegaly with a single large owl's-eye intranuclear inclusion and granular cytoplasmic inclusions, and stains with CMV rather than HSV IHC.
VZV cytopathic effect is morphologically identical; distinction requires VZV-specific IHC or PCR.

23985.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片（較厚區域）可見數顆大型反應性淋巴球：細胞質豐富且呈深藍色、邊緣更藍，核大而圓、染色質較細緻，形態像免疫母細胞（immunoblast）；背景細胞無芽細胞特徵性的一致性，符合病毒感染（H1N1 流感）引起的反應性變化。
features: Large lymphoid cells with abundant, intensely basophilic cytoplasm, deeper blue at the periphery
Round to oval nuclei with moderately fine, slightly open chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous at this resolution
Moderate N:C ratio with a paler perinuclear zone in some cells (immunoblastic/plasmacytoid features)
Scattered, heterogeneous cells rather than a monotonous population
Densely packed red cells in a thick area of the smear (limits fine assessment); no Auer rods or granules
23985.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear, examined in a relatively thick area, shows several large reactive lymphocytes with abundant, deeply basophilic cytoplasm, round to oval nuclei with moderately fine chromatin, and inconspicuous nucleoli, consistent with immunoblasts. The cells are variable in size and appearance rather than monotonous, and cytoplasmic granules or Auer rods are not seen. Red cell morphology cannot be reliably assessed in this thick portion of the film. In a patient with H1N1 influenza, findings are consistent with a reactive immunoblastic lymphocyte response to viral infection.

ddx.vs: Blasts form a monotonous population with high N:C ratio, very fine chromatin and scant cytoplasm, whereas these cells have abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm and a heterogeneous spectrum.

ddx.dx: Circulating lymphoma cells (e.g. DLBCL or plasmablastic lymphoma)
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells are monomorphic and clonal by flow cytometry, while reactive immunoblasts are polytypic and accompany a transient viral illness.
Morphology overlaps; EBV Downey cells tend to be larger with cytoplasm hugging red cells, and heterophile/EBV serology separates them from influenza.
Plasma cells have eccentric nuclei with clockface chromatin and a distinct Golgi hof and are CD138-positive monotypic cells.

15793.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大量異常前骨髓細胞，細胞質充滿粗大紫紅色顆粒而遮蓋細胞核，部分細胞可見成束的 Auer 小體（faggot cell），核呈雙葉或凹折，是高顆粒型急性前骨髓細胞白血病（APL）的典型表現。
features: Numerous large abnormal promyelocytes replacing normal marrow elements
Cytoplasm densely packed with coarse purple-red azurophilic granules that partially obscure the nucleus
Cells with bundles of multiple Auer rods (faggot cells) visible in the cytoplasm
Nuclei round to reniform or bilobed with folded outlines; chromatin fine
Some cells with a clear, granule-poor Golgi zone at the cell periphery
Background red cells forming rouleaux-like stacks
15793.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows sheets of large abnormal promyelocytes with abundant cytoplasm densely filled with coarse azurophilic granules that overlie and obscure the nuclear outline. Several cells contain bundles of Auer rods (faggot cells). The nuclei are round, reniform or bilobed with folded contours and fine chromatin. Normal maturing myeloid and erythroid precursors are not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with hypergranular acute promyelocytic leukemia; PML::RARA confirmation and immediate ATRA with coagulopathy management are indicated.

ddx.vs: Recovering marrow has normal promyelocytes with a perinuclear hof, round eccentric nuclei and orderly maturation to myelocytes and neutrophils, without Auer rods or bilobed nuclei.
AML with maturation has blasts with few granules and single Auer rods plus maturing neutrophils, and is PML::RARA negative with CD34/HLA-DR often positive.
M3v shows bilobed nuclei with sparse, fine granules and hyperleukocytosis, whereas hypergranular APL has coarse granules and conspicuous faggot cells.

ddx.dx: Acute basophilic leukemia / mast cell leukemia
ddx.vs: These have metachromatic granules that stain with toluidine blue and lack faggot cells and PML::RARA.

exam.answer_en: Hypergranular acute promyelocytic leukemia — sheets of abnormal promyelocytes with coarse nucleus-obscuring granules and faggot cells
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著含多根 Auer rods 的細胞問名稱→faggot cell，並問必考遺傳：t(15;17) PML::RARA；少見 RARA 變異夥伴如 ZBTB16::RARA 對 ATRA 反應差。
APL 出血為 DIC 合併纖溶亢進；應監測 fibrinogen、血小板、PT，積極輸注 cryoprecipitate/fibrinogen 與血小板，早期出血死亡是主要風險。
非高危險（WBC ≤10×10⁹/L）APL 標準治療為 ATRA＋arsenic trioxide（ATO），治癒率高；高危險者常加入化療（anthracycline）。
治療中注意 differentiation syndrome（發燒、呼吸困難、肺浸潤、體重增加），處置為 dexamethasone；ATO 需監測 QTc 與電解質。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 G-CSF 後或恢復期骨髓的反應性前骨髓細胞增生；後者有核旁淡染 Golgi 區、圓形偏心核並可見完整成熟，無 Auer rods 或雙葉核。

quiz.q: 圖中胞質含成束 Auer rods 的細胞叫什麼？非高危險 APL 的標準誘導治療為何？

13809.recognize_zh: A 圖骨髓切片中造血細胞幾乎消失，脂肪細胞大小不一且萎縮，周圍被淡紫色、無結構的膠狀基質包圍；B 圖此基質 Alcian blue 呈藍色陽性，C 圖另一特殊染色基質不著色，符合骨髓膠狀轉化（gelatinous transformation / serous fat atrophy）。
features: Marked hypocellularity with near-total loss of hematopoietic elements
Fat cells of variable, often small size (fat atrophy) separated by amorphous pale lilac extracellular material
Extracellular matrix is Alcian blue positive (panel B), consistent with acid mucopolysaccharide (hyaluronic acid)
Panel C special stain shows no staining of the matrix, only scattered red blood cells
No infiltrating tumor cells or granulomas identified at this magnification
13809.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (A, H&E) is markedly hypocellular, with near-complete loss of hematopoietic cells and replacement of the marrow space by atrophic fat cells of variable size embedded in an amorphous, faintly basophilic extracellular ground substance; a bony trabecula and a small hemorrhagic focus are present. The ground substance stains blue with Alcian blue (B), consistent with acid mucopolysaccharide, and does not stain with the additional special stain shown (C), which highlights only scattered red cells. No metastatic tumor cells are identified in these fields. Findings are consistent with gelatinous transformation (serous atrophy) of the bone marrow, typically associated with cachexia, severe weight loss, anorexia nervosa, chronic illness or malignancy; the clinical context of weight loss and night sweats warrants a search for an underlying disease.

ddx.vs: Amyloid is eosinophilic, often perivascular, and Congo red-positive with apple-green birefringence, whereas gelatinous material is Alcian blue-positive and Congo red-negative.

ddx.dx: Marrow edema / stromal damage after chemotherapy
ddx.vs: Post-therapy edema is eosinophilic, proteinaceous and Alcian blue-negative, with dilated sinusoids rather than acid mucopolysaccharide deposits.
Carcinoma produces mucin that is mucicarmine/PAS-positive and contains cytokeratin-positive epithelial cells, which are absent here.
Aplastic anemia shows hypocellular marrow replaced by normal-appearing mature fat without extracellular gelatinous ground substance or fat atrophy.

captions: A: H&E showing hypocellular marrow with fat atrophy and gelatinous ground substance
C: Additional special stain with non-staining matrix

exam.answer_en: Gelatinous transformation (serous atrophy) of marrow — hypocellularity, fat atrophy and amorphous Alcian blue-positive ground substance
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指脂肪細胞間的淡紫色無結構物質問「這是什麼、用什麼染色證明？」答：hyaluronic acid 為主的酸性黏多醣，Alcian blue 陽性。
三要素：造血細胞減少、脂肪細胞萎縮變小、細胞外膠狀基質沉積；抹片中常見粉紅/紫色無定形物質且抽吸量少。
常見原因：神經性厭食症與嚴重營養不良、惡病質（癌症、AIDS、結核等慢性病）、酒精中毒；病人常有全血球減少。
此變化通常可逆，改善營養與治療原發疾病後骨髓可恢復；本身不是腫瘤，但需在切片中仔細排除轉移癌。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 amyloid 或化療後骨髓水腫混淆；amyloid 呈嗜伊紅色、Congo red 陽性並有蘋果綠雙折射，水腫為蛋白性且 Alcian blue 陰性，膠狀轉化則 Alcian blue 陽性。

quiz.q: 圖 B 中呈藍色陽性的細胞外基質是用什麼染色？這種骨髓變化最典型的臨床背景為何？
quiz.a: Alcian blue（酸性黏多醣/hyaluronic acid）；神經性厭食症、嚴重營養不良或惡病質

13041.recognize_zh: 視野中有多顆帶橘紅色粗大顆粒、雙葉核的嗜酸性球，同時混有兩顆核呈腦回狀／分葉狀（cerebriform）的異型淋巴球，提示嗜酸性球增多是繼發於 T 細胞淋巴瘤（Sézary 細胞），而非原發性嗜酸性球疾病。
features: Several mature eosinophils with bilobed or multilobed nuclei and abundant orange-red granules
Two atypical lymphoid cells with convoluted, lobulated (cerebriform) nuclei and condensed chromatin
Atypical lymphoid cells have scant to moderate pale-blue agranular cytoplasm
Eosinophils show no obvious hypogranulation or dysplasia in this field
Red cells show mild rouleaux-like stacking; platelets not prominent
13041.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows increased mature eosinophils with normal-appearing coarse orange granules and bilobed to multilobed nuclei. Admixed are atypical lymphoid cells with convoluted, lobulated nuclei with condensed chromatin and a thin rim of agranular basophilic cytoplasm. No blasts are identified in this field. The combination of hypereosinophilia with circulating cerebriform lymphocytes suggests a secondary (lymphocyte-driven) eosinophilia associated with a cutaneous T-cell lymphoma, and findings are consistent with Sézary cells in mycosis fungoides/Sézary syndrome; flow cytometry (CD4+, CD7−/CD26− T cells) and TCR clonality are recommended.

ddx.dx: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and tyrosine kinase gene fusion (PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1)
ddx.vs: These primary neoplasms show eosinophilia without a circulating cerebriform T-cell population and are confirmed by FIP1L1::PDGFRA or related fusion testing.
CEL shows dysplastic or immature eosinophils and increased blasts or clonal myeloid abnormalities, not atypical lobulated lymphocytes.
L-HES has an aberrant (often CD3−CD4+) T-cell clone driving eosinophilia but lacks tissue-proven mycosis fungoides.
ATLL flower cells have petal-like polylobation and are HTLV-1 positive, often with hypercalcemia.

3313.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一顆遠大於周圍紅血球的大型細胞，核呈不規則腎形／馬蹄形、染色質粗糙，細胞質豐富灰藍色並有數個清楚空泡，符合 ALCL 腫瘤細胞的外觀。
features: Very large cell, several times the diameter of adjacent red cells
Irregular, reniform to horseshoe-shaped nucleus with coarse, reticulated chromatin
Moderate N:C ratio; nucleoli not clearly discernible
Abundant grey-blue cytoplasm with several discrete clear vacuoles and small cytoplasmic projections
Paler paranuclear cytoplasmic zone within the nuclear indentation (Golgi region)
3313.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a single very large atypical cell with abundant grey-blue cytoplasm containing several sharply punched-out vacuoles and irregular cytoplasmic projections. The nucleus is irregular and reniform to horseshoe-shaped with coarse chromatin, and a paler paranuclear zone occupies the nuclear indentation. Such cells may be sparse and easily overlooked in aspirates. Findings are consistent with an anaplastic large cell lymphoma cell in the marrow, and confirmation requires CD30 and ALK immunostaining on the core biopsy or clot section.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells usually occur in cohesive clusters and are keratin positive and CD30/ALK negative.
Monocytic blasts have fine delicate chromatin, a nucleolus and fine granules, and they are numerous and CD14/CD64 and nonspecific esterase positive.
Histiocytes have a small bland oval nucleus with low N:C ratio and often contain phagocytosed debris.
Reed-Sternberg cells have huge inclusion-like nucleoli and are CD15+ and ALK negative.

1201.recognize_zh: 積液細胞抹片中大量中到大型、胞質深藍嗜鹼性的淋巴樣細胞，中央一顆巨大多核、胞質強嗜鹼的奇異細胞，背景有嗜中性球與紅血球；這種漿母細胞樣／免疫母細胞樣大細胞在積液中出現，符合原發性積液淋巴瘤（PEL）。
features: Numerous medium-to-large discohesive lymphoid cells with round nuclei and moderate deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Central giant bizarre cell with abundant intensely basophilic cytoplasm and a large irregular/multilobated nucleus with visible nucleoli
Some tumor cells with scalloped or blebbed cytoplasmic borders
Admixed neutrophils and occasional small lymphocytes
Hemorrhagic background with abundant erythrocytes; no cohesive epithelial clusters
1201.describe_en: Cytospin preparation of an effusion shows a hemorrhagic background with numerous discohesive medium-to-large atypical lymphoid cells that have round nuclei, fine chromatin and moderate amounts of deeply basophilic cytoplasm. A large bizarre cell with an irregular multilobated nucleus and abundant intensely basophilic cytoplasm is present centrally. Scattered neutrophils and occasional small lymphocytes are seen; cohesive epithelial or mesothelial clusters are not identified. Findings are consistent with a high-grade large cell lymphoma with plasmablastic/immunoblastic features and, in the effusion setting, suggestive of primary effusion lymphoma; HHV8 (LANA) immunostaining is required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Burkitt cells are monotonous medium-sized cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing lipid vacuoles, lacking the pleomorphic giant cells seen here.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma involving effusion
ddx.vs: DLBCL expresses pan-B-cell markers (CD20, PAX5) and is HHV8-negative, whereas PEL has a null/plasmablastic phenotype.
Mesothelial cells form cohesive groups with dense cytoplasm, 'windows' and knobby borders, and are cytokeratin/calretinin positive.
Carcinoma cells form three-dimensional cohesive clusters and are epithelial-marker positive rather than dispersed CD45/CD138-positive cells.

exam.answer_en: Primary effusion lymphoma — large plasmablastic/immunoblastic cells in effusion, including a bizarre multinucleated cell with deeply basophilic cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指中央巨大多核奇異細胞，問此細胞是反應性間皮細胞還是腫瘤細胞，並要求說出 PEL 的病毒關聯與「null」表型。
表型常呈「null」：CD45+，但 CD19、CD20、CD79a、PAX5 等 B 細胞標記多陰性；表現漿細胞標記 CD138、CD38、MUM1/IRF4，常 CD30+、EMA+。
定義性檢查：HHV-8/KSHV 陽性（LANA-1 IHC），多數合併 EBV（EBER ISH）；常見於 HIV 感染者，可合併 Kaposi sarcoma 或 KSHV 相關 multicentric Castleman disease。
Ig 基因重組呈單株性可證明 B 細胞來源（即使 B 細胞標記陰性）；CD30 常陽性，勿因大型多核細胞與 CD30+ 而誤判為 ALCL。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把多核奇異細胞誤認為反應性間皮細胞或 anaplastic large cell lymphoma：間皮細胞 calretinin/keratin+、有 window 間隙；ALCL 為 T 細胞表型且 ALK 或 T 標記陽性，PEL 則 HHV-8+、漿細胞標記+。

quiz.q: 圖中巨大多核細胞若 CD20−、CD138+、CD30+，要確認 PEL 還需做哪兩項病毒檢查？
quiz.a: HHV-8 LANA-1 IHC（必要）與 EBV EBER ISH（常陽性）。

3953.recognize_zh: 一顆單核巨噬細胞（monocyte/macrophage）的空泡狀細胞質內，可見多個約 2–4 μm 的小圓形病原體，每個都有紫色核與旁邊點狀的動基體（kinetoplast），即杜氏利什曼原蟲無鞭毛體（LD bodies）。
features: Large mononuclear phagocyte with an oval to reniform nucleus and fine chromatin
Abundant vacuolated cytoplasm containing multiple small oval organisms (~2-4 um)
Each organism shows a purple nucleus and a small rod/dot-like kinetoplast
Organisms are intracellular, clustered within cytoplasmic vacuoles
Background of thick-area erythrocytes with nearby lymphocyte and monocyte
3953.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (thick area) shows a monocyte/macrophage with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm containing numerous small intracellular organisms. Each organism measures a few microns and contains a nucleus and an adjacent bar-shaped kinetoplast, without a capsule or budding. Findings are consistent with Leishmania amastigotes (Leishman-Donovan bodies), supporting visceral leishmaniasis.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts have a clear halo/pseudocapsule and lack a kinetoplast, whereas Leishmania amastigotes show a nucleus plus a distinct kinetoplast.
Toxoplasma is crescentic, lacks a kinetoplast, and is rarely seen in circulating monocytes.
Ingested platelets are granular without a consistent nucleus-kinetoplast arrangement or uniform oval shape.
Talaromyces yeasts divide by central transverse septation and lack a kinetoplast.

exam.answer_en: Visceral leishmaniasis — Leishman-Donovan bodies (amastigotes with nucleus and kinetoplast) within a monocyte/macrophage in peripheral blood
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指胞質內小圓形病原體，要求指出每個蟲體的「核＋旁邊點/桿狀 kinetoplast」，這是辨識 Leishmania amastigote 的關鍵。
檢查：骨髓抽吸是常用的組織診斷（脾抽吸敏感度高但出血風險高）；rK39 快篩血清學、PCR 輔助；周邊血找到蟲體多見於免疫低下或高蟲量者。
臨床：kala-azar 表現為長期發燒、巨脾、全血球低下、多株高γ球蛋白血症；也是次發性 HLH 的誘因之一。治療常用 liposomal amphotericin B。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 Histoplasma capsulatum：Histoplasma 酵母菌有透明暈（假莢膜）但無 kinetoplast，GMS/PAS 陽性；Toxoplasma tachyzoite 亦無 kinetoplast。

quiz.q: 圖中巨噬細胞內小圓形病原體與 Histoplasma 區分的關鍵構造是什麼？
quiz.a: Kinetoplast（核旁點/桿狀構造），為 Leishmania amastigote（LD body）特徵。

1777.recognize_zh: 臨床照片中大腿與小腿有大片融合、深紫黑色的出血壞死性瘀斑，邊界不規則並帶紅色外圈，病灶對稱擴展於下肢，符合水痘感染後因後天性蛋白 S 缺乏引起的暴發性紫斑（purpura fulminans）。
features: Large confluent ecchymotic plaques on the posterior thigh and lower leg
Central dark purple-black discoloration suggesting hemorrhagic necrosis
Sharply demarcated, irregular geographic borders with an erythematous rim
Lesions much larger than petechiae or ordinary bruises
No discrete vesicles evident in this view
1777.describe_en: Clinical photograph of the lower extremity shows large, confluent, sharply demarcated purpuric plaques over the thigh and leg with dark purple-black centers and irregular erythematous borders, indicating hemorrhagic skin necrosis. No vesicular lesions are evident in this view. In a child recovering from varicella, the appearance is consistent with post-varicella purpura fulminans, typically due to acquired anti-protein S autoantibodies with consumptive coagulopathy; protein C/S levels and DIC studies are indicated.

ddx.vs: Occurs with fulminant sepsis and shock at presentation, rather than days to weeks after varicella in a well-appearing child with low protein S.
Arises in fatty areas within days of starting warfarin, often with underlying protein C deficiency.
ITP produces petechiae and ecchymoses without skin necrosis and with normal coagulation studies.
Vasculitis presents as palpable purpura of smaller lesions rather than large confluent necrotic plaques.

1969.recognize_zh: 箭頭處為一顆比淋巴球大約兩倍的圓形細胞，胞質充滿粗大、密集的紫藍與暗紫色顆粒並部分覆蓋細胞核，顆粒間帶粉紅底色，屬於顆粒尚未成熟、呈嗜鹼性染色的嗜伊紅前驅細胞；需與嗜鹼球區分。
features: Large round cell (about twice the size of adjacent lymphocytes) indicated by arrow
Cytoplasm packed with coarse, dense dark purple to blue-violet granules on a pinkish background
Granules partially overlie and obscure a round nucleus
Two small lymphocytes adjacent and another lymphocyte at the lower right
Background red cells normocytic, with slight overlap
1969.describe_en: Smear shows a large round granulocytic precursor containing abundant coarse dark purple to violet granules on a pinkish cytoplasmic background, partially obscuring a round nucleus, adjacent to small mature lymphocytes. The granules are larger and more uniform than those of a basophil and lack the black water-soluble quality of basophil granules. The appearance is consistent with an immature eosinophilic precursor (eosinophilic promyelocyte/myelocyte) whose primary granules still stain basophilic; such cells may be seen in eosinophilic disorders, CML and occasionally AML with inv(16).

ddx.vs: Smaller cell with fewer, variably sized black-purple granules that often wash out and a segmented nucleus, rather than densely packed uniform granules on a pink background.
Larger, often oval or spindled cell with a central round nucleus and uniform dark metachromatic granules, found mainly in marrow particles.

ddx.dx: Abnormal eosinophil of AML with inv(16)
ddx.vs: Contains very large purple-violet granules in eosinophils with increased myelomonocytic blasts and CBFB::MYH11.

1329.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中許多紅血球內可見細小、深色的點狀包涵體，符合 Howell-Jolly 小體，提示類澱粉沉積於脾臟造成的功能性脾臟低下（functional hyposplenism）；解析度偏低，需以高倍確認。
features: Normocytic red cells with scattered small, dense, dark inclusions in numerous cells, consistent with Howell-Jolly bodies
Occasional target-like and irregular red cells
Two lymphocytes in the center and one at the upper left with round dense nuclei
Platelets present as small scattered granular forms
Image resolution is low, limiting assessment of inclusion detail
1329.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cells of fairly uniform size, many of which contain small, dense, dark inclusions most consistent with Howell-Jolly bodies; occasional target-like cells are also seen. Lymphocytes and scattered platelets are present, and no circulating plasma cells or schistocytes are identified in this field. The low image resolution limits distinction from Pappenheimer bodies or stain precipitate. In a patient with systemic AL amyloidosis, these findings suggest functional hyposplenism from splenic amyloid infiltration; the smear itself is not diagnostic of amyloidosis or factor X deficiency.

ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; history of splenectomy versus imaging/biopsy evidence of splenic amyloid separates them.
Pappenheimer bodies are multiple, fine, clustered granules at the cell periphery that stain with Prussian blue, whereas Howell-Jolly bodies are usually single, round, dense DNA remnants.
Precipitate lies on top of cells and in the background in varying focal planes, not as uniform round inclusions within red cells.

2609.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一顆巨大原紅血球，細胞質深藍並有鈍圓的偽足狀突起，核大、染色質細緻並可見數個深色核仁樣結構，下方一顆較小的原紅血球作對比，符合微小病毒 B19 感染。
features: Giant pronormoblast, several times the diameter of adjacent red cells
Large round nucleus with finely granular chromatin and dark nucleolus-like bodies
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with blunt cytoplasmic protrusions (blebs)
Paler perinuclear zone around the nucleus
Smaller pronormoblast beneath for size comparison; a neutrophil and myeloid cell nearby
2609.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a giant pronormoblast with a large round nucleus, finely granular chromatin and several dark nucleolus-like bodies. The cytoplasm is deeply basophilic with blunt protrusions and a paler perinuclear zone. A smaller, more typical pronormoblast lies directly beneath for comparison, and a neutrophil and myeloid precursor are present nearby. Findings are suggestive of parvovirus B19 infection, particularly in the setting of red cell aplasia; B19 PCR or immunohistochemistry can confirm.

ddx.vs: Megakaryoblasts also show cytoplasmic blebs, but they lack the erythroid perinuclear clearing and are CD41/CD61 positive rather than E-cadherin/glycophorin positive.
Pure erythroid leukemia forms sheets of proerythroblasts, whereas here giant cells are isolated in an otherwise non-erythroid-predominant marrow.
Tumor cells cluster with nuclear pleomorphism and variable cytoplasmic features rather than showing deep erythroid basophilia.
MDS shows megaloblastoid changes, multinucleation and ring sideroblasts across maturation stages rather than giant early precursors alone.

exam.answer_en: Parvovirus B19 infection — giant pronormoblast with deeply basophilic, blebbed cytoplasm beside a normal-sized pronormoblast
pearls_zh: 考法：這張有一顆正常大小的 pronormoblast 在旁當尺，考官會問「上方這顆巨大細胞與下方那顆差在哪？」；答同為 erythroid 系，上方為 B19 造成的 giant pronormoblast。
周邊血最重要的配套數據是 reticulocyte count 接近 0；骨髓紅血球系除少數巨大原紅血球外幾乎缺乏後續成熟階段（maturation arrest）。
切片上典型病毒變化是核內 glassy、嗜伊紅性 inclusion 將染色質推向周邊（lantern cell），可用 B19 IHC 或 PCR 確認。
免疫低下者（HIV、移植、化療）的 chronic PRCA 以 IVIG 治療；鐮刀型貧血或 HS 病人急性 aplastic crisis 可能需輸血支持。
exam.pitfall_zh: 胞質突起易讓人誤認為 megakaryoblast：megakaryoblast 無 erythroid 的核周淡染區且 CD41/CD61+；B19 巨大細胞為 E-cadherin/glycophorin 系陽性並伴 reticulocytopenia。

quiz.q: 圖中上方的巨大細胞代表何種感染？周邊血最典型的伴隨實驗室發現是什麼？
quiz.a: Parvovirus B19；reticulocytopenia（網狀紅血球顯著減少）

1073.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指為一顆小型漿細胞，核上有一顆淡藍色圓形小體；周圍多顆漿細胞（包括一顆雙核漿細胞）核上都有多個淡藍色圓形小體，即Dutcher bodies。
features: Numerous plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm
Pale blue, round, sharply outlined intranuclear inclusions (Dutcher bodies), single (arrow) or multiple per nucleus
Binucleate plasma cell with multiple inclusions in both nuclei
Some plasma cells enlarged with more dispersed chromatin
Background maturing granulocytes, erythroid precursors, and a band neutrophil
1073.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows increased plasma cells, including a binucleate form, with eccentric nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm. Many nuclei contain one to several pale blue, round, sharply demarcated inclusions consistent with Dutcher bodies (arrow). Maturing myeloid and erythroid precursors are present in the background. The presence of numerous Dutcher bodies favors a clonal plasma cell or lymphoplasmacytic proliferation; correlation with light-chain restriction and plasma cell quantitation is recommended.

ddx.vs: Russell bodies are located within the cytoplasm and distend it, rather than overlying the nucleus.
Nucleoli are deeper purple, often single and central, and not the glassy pale-blue globules of Dutcher bodies.
Dutcher bodies are rare in reactive plasma cells, which are polytypic by kappa/lambda studies.

exam.answer_en: Clonal plasma cell / lymphoplasmacytic neoplasm — increased plasma cells with numerous Dutcher bodies (pale intranuclear pseudoinclusions)
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指箭頭那顆漿細胞核上的淡藍圓形小體，問「這是什麼構造、在核內還是細胞質？」答 Dutcher body：細胞質 immunoglobulin 內陷入核形成的假包涵體，PAS 陽性。
Dutcher bodies 大量出現時強烈提示 clonal 疾病，最常連到 lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma/Waldenström macroglobulinemia（MYD88 L265P）、marginal zone lymphoma，也可見於 plasma cell myeloma。
必考關聯檢查：SPEP + immunofixation、serum free light chain、骨髓 CD138 計數，並以 flow 或 kappa/lambda IHC/ISH 證明 light-chain restriction。
Plasma cell myeloma（IMWG）：骨髓 clonal plasma cells ≥10% 或活檢證實 plasmacytoma，加上 CRAB 或 SLiM 任一 myeloma-defining event；clonal plasma cells ≥60% 本身即屬 SLiM。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常被誤認為 Russell bodies：Russell body 位於細胞質、把細胞質撐開；Dutcher body 疊在核上（核內假包涵體）。也別當成核仁——核仁顏色較深紫、嵌在染色質中。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指漿細胞核上的淡藍色圓形小體稱為什麼？最常與哪一種淋巴瘤相關？

4209.recognize_zh: 脾臟免疫染色中紅髓內散布大量陽性的大型細胞，而右側與下方的白髓區域大多為陰性，顯示紅髓內有活化的免疫母細胞類族群浸潤；抗體名稱未標示。
features: Numerous positive medium to large cells scattered throughout the red pulp
Positive cells vary in size and distribution, with focal perivascular accumulation
Rounded white pulp areas largely negative (right and lower field)
Background stroma and remaining cells negative (blue counterstain)
Specific antibody or probe not labeled
4209.describe_en: Immunostained splenic section at low-medium power shows many positive medium to large cells distributed diffusely through the red pulp, with relative sparing of the white pulp areas. The morphology of the positive cells suggests an activated or immunoblastic population. The specific marker is not labeled, which limits interpretation. In the context of infectious mononucleosis, a red pulp distribution of activated lymphoid cells (e.g., EBV-infected or cytotoxic T-cells) is expected and contributes to capsular infiltration and rupture.

ddx.vs: DLBCL forms confluent sheets or nodules of uniformly large atypical cells effacing architecture, rather than scattered cells in preserved red pulp.
cHL shows rare CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells in white pulp nodules with a mixed inflammatory background, not numerous positive red pulp cells.

4145.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片被大量中型、核質比極高、染色質細緻、細胞質極少的母細胞取代，部分核有凹陷或扭曲（convoluted），僅殘留少數粒系細胞，符合淋巴母細胞白血病；T 系需以流式確認（cCD3+）。
features: Sheets of small-to-medium blasts replacing normal marrow elements
Very high N:C ratio with scant basophilic cytoplasm
Round to irregular, occasionally convoluted or indented nuclei with finely dispersed to slightly condensed chromatin
Inconspicuous to small nucleoli; no Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules
Few residual segmented neutrophils and erythroid precursors
Numerous small cytoplasmic/background vacuoles in the thick area
4145.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hypercellular specimen largely replaced by small-to-medium blasts with very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round to convoluted nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm. Auer rods are not seen. Residual granulocytic and erythroid elements are markedly decreased. Findings are consistent with acute lymphoblastic leukemia; lineage assignment as T-lymphoblastic leukemia requires flow cytometry demonstrating cytoplasmic CD3 with TdT and other T-cell antigens.

ddx.vs: B-ALL blasts look identical on smear and are distinguished only by immunophenotype (CD19, CD79a, PAX5 versus cCD3).
Minimally differentiated AML blasts are MPO-negative on cytochemistry but express CD13/CD33/CD117 without cCD3.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent lipid vacuoles and are TdT-negative mature B cells.

ddx.dx: Leukemic phase of mantle cell lymphoma (blastoid)
ddx.vs: Blastoid MCL is TdT-negative, CD5+/cyclin D1+ mature B-cell.

3889.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中（箭頭）可見數個由深染小型淋巴球組成、界線清楚的結節狀聚集，位於骨小樑之間，不在骨小樑旁，周圍仍有正常三系造血與脂肪，是 CLL 的結節型浸潤模式。
features: Well-demarcated nodular aggregates of dark-staining small lymphoid cells (arrows)
Nodules located in the interstitium, not paratrabecular
Intervening normocellular marrow with preserved trilineage hematopoiesis and adipocytes
Bony trabecula without paratrabecular lymphoid infiltration
No diffuse replacement at this power
3889.describe_en: Low-power view of the bone marrow biopsy shows several well-circumscribed, non-paratrabecular nodular aggregates of dark-staining small lymphoid cells (arrows) within an otherwise normocellular marrow with preserved trilineage hematopoiesis and adipocytes. There is no diffuse marrow replacement or paratrabecular infiltration in this field. In the appropriate clinical and immunophenotypic context, findings are consistent with a nodular pattern of involvement by chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Reactive aggregates are usually small, few, well-circumscribed, often with germinal centers or vessels and a mixed T/B composition, whereas CLL nodules are more numerous and composed of CD5/CD23-positive B cells.
Follicular lymphoma characteristically forms paratrabecular aggregates of centrocytes that are CD10/BCL6 positive and CD5 negative.
Mantle cell lymphoma can be nodular or interstitial but is cyclin D1/SOX11 positive and CD23 negative.
MZL shows nodular or intrasinusoidal infiltrates of CD5- and CD23-negative B cells, often with plasmacytic differentiation.

3825.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有一顆大型組織球，細胞質淡藍、充滿大小不一的空泡呈泡沫狀，核小而圓，被正常造血細胞包圍；左側另見一團含空泡的組織球，符合 Niemann-Pick 泡沫細胞。
features: Large histiocyte with abundant pale, finely vacuolated foamy cytoplasm and a small round nucleus (center)
Additional vacuolated histiocytic cells at left edge of field
Cytoplasm lacks fibrillary striations; some larger clear vacuoles present
Surrounding hematopoietic cells show normal maturation (myelocytes, bands, erythroid precursors, lymphocytes)
Background red cells and platelets unremarkable
3825.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large histiocyte with a small round nucleus and abundant pale, foamy cytoplasm containing numerous fine and some larger clear vacuoles; additional vacuolated histiocytes are seen at the left margin. The background shows maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors and lymphocytes without obvious dysplasia or increased blasts. Findings are consistent with lipid-laden foam cells, compatible with marrow involvement by Niemann-Pick disease in the appropriate clinical setting.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells show fibrillary, striated cytoplasm resembling crumpled tissue paper rather than round vacuoles.
Hemophagocytic macrophages contain engulfed red cells, platelets, or nucleated cells rather than uniform lipid vacuoles.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain blue-green granular pigment on Wright-Giemsa rather than clear foamy vacuoles.

ddx.dx: Metastatic signet-ring or clear cell tumor cells
ddx.vs: Tumor cells show nuclear atypia, cohesion, and epithelial markers, unlike these bland single histiocytes.

3697.recognize_zh: 淋巴結 H&E 切片中大片區域布滿核碎裂碎屑（karyorrhectic debris）與淡嗜酸性壞死背景，混有組織球，但幾乎看不到嗜中性球；中央血管壁呈纖維素樣改變，符合菊池病（Kikuchi lymphadenitis）的壞死期表現。
features: Extensive paracortical-type necrosis with abundant karyorrhectic nuclear debris
Eosinophilic fibrinoid background with scattered histiocytes and immunoblast-like cells
Conspicuous absence of neutrophils and eosinophils
Central vessel with eosinophilic fibrinoid wall change surrounded by necrotic debris
No well-formed granulomas or sheets of atypical large cells at this power
3697.describe_en: Section of lymph node shows a large area of necrosis composed of abundant karyorrhectic debris in an eosinophilic fibrinoid background, admixed with histiocytes and scattered mononuclear cells. Neutrophils are notably absent, and no granulomas are identified. A small vessel within the lesion shows fibrinoid wall change. Findings are consistent with histiocytic necrotizing lymphadenitis (Kikuchi-Fujimoto disease), necrotizing phase; correlation with CD68/MPO-positive crescentic histiocytes and exclusion of lupus lymphadenitis and lymphoma are recommended.

ddx.vs: May be histologically identical but often shows hematoxylin bodies, plasma cells, and neutrophils, with positive ANA/anti-dsDNA serology.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell or diffuse large B-cell lymphoma with necrosis
ddx.vs: Shows sheets of cytologically atypical large cells with monotypic or aberrant immunophenotype rather than mixed histiocytes and CD8+ T cells.
Contains abundant neutrophils and often granulomas, and special stains or cultures may reveal organisms.
Necrosis contains neutrophils and viral inclusions with multinucleated cells, confirmed by HSV immunostain.

exam.answer_en: Kikuchi-Fujimoto disease (histiocytic necrotizing lymphadenitis) — karyorrhectic necrosis with histiocytes and absent neutrophils
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指大片核碎屑壞死區，問為何不是化膿性淋巴腺炎；關鍵答案是「沒有中性球」且無肉芽腫。
典型病人：年輕女性（東亞常見），發燒、頸部淋巴結疼痛腫大、白血球低下；多為自限性，數週至數月內緩解。
IHC：組織球 CD68+ 且 MPO+，大量 CD123+ plasmacytoid dendritic cells，T 細胞以 CD8+ 為主。
需排除 SLE lymphadenitis（有 hematoxylin bodies、漿細胞較多），並長期追蹤 ANA，因部分病人日後發生 SLE。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最危險的誤判是當成 T 細胞淋巴瘤；Kikuchi 的活化 CD8+ 細胞與組織球混雜、有大量核碎屑，無單一形態的異型細胞片狀浸潤，也無 TCR 單株性。

quiz.q: 這張淋巴結切片有大量核碎屑壞死卻看不到中性球，最可能的診斷是什麼？需與哪個自體免疫疾病鑑別？

3505.recognize_zh: 低倍下紅血球在整片抹片中聚成大小不一、形狀不規則的團塊，而不是排成錢串狀（rouleaux），符合冷凝集素造成的紅血球凝集。
features: Low-power view with red cells forming numerous irregular, variably sized three-dimensional clumps throughout the smear
Clumps are amorphous rather than linear stacks, distinguishing agglutination from rouleaux
Intervening single RBCs present between aggregates
Few scattered leukocytes; individual cell detail not assessable at this magnification
3505.describe_en: Low-power examination of the peripheral blood smear shows extensive red cell agglutination, with irregular, variably sized clumps of erythrocytes distributed across the entire field. The aggregates are amorphous rather than linear, arguing against rouleaux. Scattered leukocytes are seen; fine morphologic detail is limited at this magnification. Findings are consistent with red cell agglutination, as seen in cold agglutinin disease (e.g., secondary to Mycoplasma infection).

ddx.vs: Rouleaux form linear coin-stack arrays associated with increased plasma proteins, whereas agglutinates are irregular grape-like clumps that disperse on warming if cold-mediated.
Artifactual overlap is confined to the thick portion of the smear, whereas true agglutination persists into the thin feathered edge.
Warm AIHA typically shows spherocytes without prominent agglutination, and DAT is IgG-positive rather than C3d-only.

exam.answer_en: Cold agglutinin–mediated RBC agglutination (e.g., post-Mycoplasma) — irregular 3D red cell clumps, not rouleaux
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍看到紅血球成不規則團塊，問 agglutination 還是 rouleaux，以及最可能的抗體類型與感染（Mycoplasma pneumoniae）。
冷凝集素多為 IgM：Mycoplasma 相關常為 anti-I，EBV 傳染性單核球症相關為 anti-i；DAT 典型 C3d 陽性、IgG 陰性。
檢驗假象：CBC 出現 RBC 數與 Hct 假性下降、MCV 與 MCHC 假性升高；檢體 37°C 回溫後重測可改善。
處理：保暖、避免寒冷暴露，輸血時使用血液加溫器；Mycoplasma 相關者多為暫時性，隨感染緩解。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤判為 rouleaux：rouleaux 為線狀錢串、見於高球蛋白血症，以生理食鹽水置換可分散；凝集為不規則葡萄串團塊，冷型者加溫可散開。

quiz.q: 圖中紅血球聚集屬於 rouleaux 還是 agglutination？此情境 DAT 的典型結果為何？

3377.recognize_zh: 高倍三色染色（trichrome）可見藍色膠原纖維呈平行流線狀穿過骨髓，細胞之間有多顆褐綠色顆粒狀含色素巨噬細胞，表示纖維化伴含鐵血黃素沉積。
features: Blue-staining collagen fibers running in parallel streaming bundles on trichrome
Residual cells with red-staining nuclei entrapped between collagen strands
Macrophages with coarse brown-green granular pigment (likely hemosiderin)
Elongated spindle cells aligned with the fibers
Loose edematous spaces between fiber bundles
3377.describe_en: High-power view of a bone marrow core biopsy stained with Masson trichrome shows blue-staining collagen fibers arranged in parallel, streaming bundles that separate residual marrow cells. Scattered macrophages contain coarse brown-green granular pigment, most consistent with hemosiderin. Spindled stromal cells are aligned along the fibers. Findings are consistent with collagen fibrosis of the marrow; the underlying cause (reactive versus myeloproliferative or infiltrative) requires correlation with the overall biopsy, reticulin grade and clinical data.

ddx.vs: PMF shows clustered, bizarre megakaryocytes and osteosclerosis with JAK2/CALR/MPL mutation, which must be sought beyond this field.
Metastases show cohesive atypical epithelial or melanocytic cells within the collagen, highlighted by keratin or melanoma markers.
Mastocytosis fibrosis contains spindled mast cells with CD117/tryptase/CD25 positivity, often in paratrabecular or perivascular aggregates.

3249.recognize_zh: 一顆細胞質充滿大小空泡的巨噬細胞內，可見數個（約 4 個）小橢圓形酵母菌，周圍有透亮暈圈，菌體內有偏心的新月形紫色染色質，符合 Histoplasma capsulatum。
features: Large macrophage with abundant foamy, heavily vacuolated cytoplasm
Nucleus with multiple clear intranuclear/overlying vacuoles
Few (about four) intracellular small oval yeasts, about 2-4 um
Each yeast with a clear refractile halo and eccentric crescent-shaped purple chromatin
No hyphae; organisms scant rather than packed
3249.describe_en: Aspirate smear shows a large macrophage with abundant foamy, heavily vacuolated cytoplasm containing a small number of uniform, oval intracellular yeast forms. Each organism has a clear surrounding halo and an eccentric crescent-shaped chromatin body. No hyphae are seen. Findings are consistent with Histoplasma capsulatum; when organisms are scant, careful search of additional macrophages and confirmation by GMS stain, antigen testing or culture are advised.

ddx.vs: Leishmania shows a round nucleus plus a separate rod-shaped kinetoplast and no clear halo.
Talaromyces forms elongated yeasts with a central septum dividing by fission.
Ingested platelets or debris are irregular granular fragments without a defined cell wall, halo and crescentic chromatin.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescent-shaped organisms with a central nucleus, lacking a halo.

exam.answer_en: Histoplasmosis — intracellular small oval yeasts with clear halo and crescentic chromatin within a marrow macrophage
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指巨噬細胞內的小圓體，問「是什麼病原、如何與 Leishmania 區分」；重點是透亮暈圈與偏心新月形染色質、無 kinetoplast。
確認：GMS 或 PAS 染色可見酵母菌壁；urine/serum Histoplasma antigen 敏感度高，培養需較長時間。
臨床連結：骨髓看到 Histoplasma 代表 disseminated histoplasmosis，多見於 HIV/AIDS、器官移植、TNF inhibitor 等免疫低下者，可合併 HLH 與全血球低下。
治療：重症 disseminated 病例首選 liposomal amphotericin B，之後以 itraconazole 降階維持。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 Leishmania amastigote；Leishmania 有獨立棒狀 kinetoplast、無暈圈，Histoplasma 有 halo 且只有新月形染色質。

quiz.q: 巨噬細胞內這些帶透亮暈圈的小卵圓體是什麼病原？哪一項特殊染色可確認？

3185.recognize_zh: 中央一個大型組織球，胞質淡藍、含多團粗大深藍色顆粒（sea-blue histiocyte樣），並吞入一顆有核細胞；四周圍繞胞質充滿紫紅色粗顆粒的異常前骨髓細胞，呈現APL合併儲積細胞的組合。
features: Large histiocyte with pale blue, finely vacuolated cytoplasm containing clumps of coarse dark blue granules
Phagocytosed nucleated cell and a small dense nucleus within or overlying the histiocyte
Surrounding sheets of large abnormal promyelocytes with cytoplasm packed with purple azurophilic granules
Promyelocyte nuclei folded to reniform with fine chromatin
Occasional small cells with dense nuclei (erythroid precursor/lymphocyte) in the background
3185.describe_en: Aspirate smear shows a large histiocyte with pale blue cytoplasm containing coarse dark blue granular aggregates and an engulfed nucleated cell. The histiocyte is surrounded by numerous abnormal promyelocytes with abundant cytoplasm densely filled with azurophilic granules and folded nuclei. Findings are consistent with a sea-blue-type storage histiocyte, as seen in Niemann-Pick disease, in a marrow involved by acute promyelocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have striated 'wrinkled tissue paper' cytoplasm rather than clumped blue granules and vacuoles.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher / sea-blue histiocytes secondary to high cell turnover
ddx.vs: Secondary storage histiocytes occur in CML, thalassemia and other high-turnover states, so an inherited storage disease needs enzyme or genetic confirmation.
Hemosiderin appears golden-brown to blue-black and refractile and is Prussian blue positive, rather than sea-blue granules.

3121.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片幾乎全被大型原紅血球樣母細胞佔據：核圓、染色質細緻、有核仁，胞質深藍並帶有小空泡，缺乏骨髓球系細胞，符合純紅血球白血病（pure erythroid leukemia）。
features: Sheets of large immature erythroid precursors (proerythroblast-like) dominating the field
Round nuclei with finely granular chromatin and occasional nucleoli
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with small, discrete punched-out vacuoles
Admixed smaller, more mature erythroblasts with dense nuclei
Myeloid precursors scarce
3121.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a near-complete replacement by large immature erythroid precursors with round nuclei, finely granular chromatin, occasional nucleoli, and deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing discrete small vacuoles. Scattered more mature erythroblasts are present, and granulocytic precursors are scarce. Findings are consistent with pure erythroid leukemia (acute erythroid leukemia), which requires erythroid precursors at least 80% with at least 30% proerythroblasts; E-cadherin/CD71 and TP53 studies support the diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic anemia shows orderly maturation with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, giant metamyelocytes, and resolves with B12/folate, without a proerythroblast-dominant population.
Megakaryoblasts have cytoplasmic blebs and express CD41/CD61 rather than E-cadherin, CD71, and glycophorin.
Parvovirus shows only scattered giant pronormoblasts with intranuclear inclusions amid erythroid hypoplasia, not sheets.

ddx.dx: Lymphoma or other small round blue cell tumor
ddx.vs: These lack erythroid markers and the characteristic vacuolated basophilic cytoplasm, and are identified by lineage-specific immunostains.

exam.answer_en: Pure erythroid leukemia (acute erythroid leukemia) — sheets of proerythroblast-like blasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and punched-out vacuoles
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著胞質深藍、有小而分明空泡的大型母細胞，問是哪一系的 blast；空泡加深藍胞質是 proerythroblast 線索。
WHO 5th：acute erythroid leukemia 需紅血球系前驅細胞 ≥80%，其中 proerythroblasts ≥30%；ICC 2022 多將其歸入 AML with mutated TP53。
此類 blast 常 CD34−、HLA-DR−、MPO−，一般髓系 flow 容易漏抓；IHC 以 E-cadherin、CD71、glycophorin A（成熟度越低越可能陰性）確認紅系。
與 biallelic TP53 突變及 complex karyotype 高度相關，預後極差。
PAS 在異常紅系母細胞可呈粗顆粒或塊狀陽性，是傳統細胞化學考點。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 megaloblastic anemia；後者有 N:C 不同步但成熟有序、伴 giant metamyelocyte，補 B12/葉酸可逆，不會有成片 proerythroblast。

quiz.q: 圖中胞質深藍帶空泡的大型母細胞屬於哪一系？用哪兩個 IHC 標記可確認？

3057.recognize_zh: 低倍下的酸洗脫（Kleihauer-Betke）染色，視野內幾乎所有紅血球都保留均勻的粉紅色，看不到明顯的空白鬼影細胞，表示胎兒血紅素呈全細胞（pancellular）分布，符合 HbS/HPFH。
features: Low-power view of an acid-elution (Kleihauer-Betke type) stained blood film
Nearly all red cells retain eosin (pink) staining with fairly uniform intensity
No distinct population of pale 'ghost' cells separating stained from unstained cells
Pattern indicates pancellular distribution of fetal hemoglobin
Cellular detail limited at this magnification
3057.describe_en: Low-power view of a peripheral blood film stained by the acid-elution (Kleihauer-Betke) method. Essentially all red cells retain pink eosin staining with relatively even intensity, and a separate population of eluted ghost cells is not apparent. Individual cell morphology cannot be assessed at this magnification. The pancellular distribution of fetal hemoglobin is consistent with hereditary persistence of fetal hemoglobin coinherited with hemoglobin S (HbS/HPFH).

ddx.dx: Sickle cell-beta0 thalassemia or HbSS with hydroxyurea
ddx.vs: These show heterocellular HbF, with a mixture of stained F-cells and pale ghost cells, rather than uniform staining of all cells.
Fetal hemorrhage produces a small discrete population of darkly stained fetal cells among a majority of maternal ghost cells.
HbF distribution is heterocellular with microcytosis and hemolysis, whereas deletional HPFH gives pancellular staining with normal indices; molecular testing separates them.

2993.recognize_zh: 中央一顆大細胞沒有核膜，染色質已凝集成一條條彎曲的染色體（prophase/prometaphase），外圍是一圈淡藍色細胞質；周圍是正常成熟中的紅血球母細胞與顆粒球。
features: Large round cell with no discernible nuclear membrane
Chromatin condensed into discrete, thread-like, curved chromosomes (prophase to prometaphase)
Rim of moderately abundant pale blue cytoplasm with fine stippling
Surrounding normal marrow elements: orthochromatic normoblasts, band neutrophil, myelocytes
No atypia of the surrounding cells
2993.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a mixture of maturing erythroid and granulocytic precursors. A large cell in the center contains condensed, individually discernible chromosomes without a nuclear membrane, surrounded by pale blue cytoplasm, representing a cell in early mitosis (prophase/prometaphase). Adjacent cells, including late normoblasts and a band neutrophil, show normal maturation without dysplasia. Findings are consistent with a normal mitotic figure in reactive or normal marrow.

ddx.vs: Apoptotic cells show dense, round, fragmented chromatin balls rather than elongated, thread-like chromosomes.
Atypical mitoses are multipolar or show lagging chromosomes and occur among cytologically atypical cells, unlike this orderly figure in a normal background.
Megaloblasts retain an intact nuclear membrane with sieve-like chromatin rather than discrete condensed chromosomes.
